request:
Which modules of the click library package (files under src/click/) start with a module docstring (a leading # comment block is not a docstring)? Give the repository-relative file path.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: This query finds files in the click package that have a [PURPOSE] heading in their module docstring, which indicates the presence of a module docstring. The [PURPOSE] heading is one of the fixed headings that appears in module docstrings when they exist.
sql: SELECT f.file_id AS file_path FROM code.files f WHERE f.package = 'click' AND f.module IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.headings h WHERE h.file_id = f.file_id AND h.heading = '[PURPOSE]') ORDER BY f.file_id
